rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent canted block in all four views, so gesture clarity and repair integrity are decent. However, it is essentially a generic lifted box with a shear, with almost no productive carved void or active ground response to the verified access edge. The blue frontage is not answered by an entry seam, court, undercut, or public threshold; the mass remains sealed and semantically opposite to the neighborhood_living brief. The silhouette is also closer to a simple slanted extrusion than a program-driven section, so the section/roof logic does not support a mixed neighborhood building with active ground and public space. References suggest that a compact dominant mass can be acceptable, but only when paired with a meaningful base condition or a spatial cut; here that relation is missing.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Tall compact mass with a distinct tapered/stepped profile; useful as a precedent for a single dominant body with calibrated upper articulation.
